import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int MAXN = 250005;
    static int[][] f = new int[MAXN][18];
    static int[] c = new int[18];
    static int[] ans = new int[18];
    static int[] lg = new int[1];
    static int m, n, k, rhl;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] inv = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cnt = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] v = new int[MAXN];

    static void addArrays(int[] a, int[] b, int fg) {
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) {
            a[i] += fg != 0 ? b[i] : (rhl - b[i]);
            if (a[i] >= rhl) a[i] -= rhl;
        }
    }

    static void multiply(int[] a, int[] b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < c.length; ++i) c[i] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) {
            if (a[i] == 0) continue;
            for (int j = 0; i + j < lg[0]; ++j) {
                c[i + j] = (int)((1L * a[i] * b[j] + c[i + j]) % rhl);
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(c, 0, a, 0, c.length);
    }

    static void fastPower(int[] a, long b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < ans.length; ++i) ans[i] = 0;
        ans[0] = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) multiply(ans, a);
            b >>= 1;
            if (b > 0) multiply(a, a);
        }
        System.arraycopy(ans, 0, a, 0, ans.length);
    }

    static long powerMod(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % rhl;
            a = (a * a) % rhl;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        rhl = sc.nextInt();

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(powerMod(k, n));
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = ifac[0] = f[0][0] = 1;
        lg[0] = 0;
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; m <<= 1) {
            lg[0]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            inv[i] = (i == 1) ? 1 : (int)((1L * (rhl - rhl / i) * inv[rhl % i]) % rhl);
            fac[i] = (int)((1L * fac[i - 1] * i) % rhl);
            ifac[i] = (int)((1L * ifac[i - 1] * inv[i]) % rhl);
            cnt[i] = cnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
            f[i][cnt[i]] = ifac[i];
        }

        v[n] = 1;
        for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) {
            if (v[i] == 0) continue;
            for (int j = i; j > 0; j &= i) {
                v[j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << lg[0]); i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if ((j & i) != 0) {
                    addArrays(f[j], f[j ^ i], 1);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (v[i] != 0) {
                fastPower(f[i], k);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << lg[0]); i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if ((j & i) != 0) {
                    addArrays(f[j], f[j ^ i], 0);
                }
            }
        }

        long result = (powerMod(k, n) - (1L * f[n][cnt[n]] * fac[n] % rhl) + rhl) % rhl;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
